samples.title: One-page PDF

samples.title: Three-page PDF
samples.description: Synthetic three-page pdf for document testing.

samples.title: PDF with a table

samples.testScenario: Check layout and text extraction from a table-like document.

samples.title: PDF with links and bookmarks

samples.title: PDF with an interactive form
